The overflow requires a detail=none FTS5 table and a prefix MATCH query. LeadZen, Django and openoutfind create no FTS5 tables and expose no arbitrary-SQL path; LeadZen issues only fixed PRAGMA/schema statements and ORM queries. Recovery opens only operator-supplied backups. The exact report lists no compatible Debian fix (SQLite fix is in 3.54.0).

The overflow is in zlib's gzFile write path (gz_write after a failed write()). In the image only dpkg-deb and libapt-pkg import gzwrite/gzputs/gzprintf, and LeadZen never runs package tooling; its uid 1000 runtime cannot install packages. CPython's zlib and gzip modules use the deflate stream API, not gzFile, and no native extension in /opt/venv imports it. The exact report lists no compatible Debian fix.
